each_allow_release.path: allow_release calls resolve_catalog_release before writing the manifest-bound allowance.

each_resolve_release.path: resolve_release verifies allowance/manifest then resolve_catalog_release -> resolve_program -> sha256_file for both images.

Both timeout stopping stages are consistent with repeated large-image verification cost, but CPU/fsync/I/O attribution still requires focused observation.
